course.title: Software Engineering Specialist
course.description: Postgraduate specialization in Software Engineering at the University of Sao Paulo (USP/ESALQ)
course.details: The program covered software architecture, design patterns, agile methodologies, project management, and culminated in a Design Thinking capstone project: Atalaia Pro — a SPA/PWA system developed to improve communication in port control, capable of reducing report preparation time by up to 82%.

description.label: description
description.value: I built Avape, a pawn-evaluation platform for assessors across three sectors: gemology, watchmaking, and high-value pens. The gemology module offers tools for calculating gem qualities and characteristics, while the watchmaking and pens modules let users maintain item databases with detailed records and images.

details.label: details
details.value: Developed with TypeScript on Next.js and a PostgreSQL database managed with Prisma, the system integrates JWT authentication for access control, TanStack Query for data fetching and caching, and TanStack Table for fast, responsive data tables. It keeps a full content-change log for auditing and is fully operational and responsive on desktop and mobile.

description.label: description
description.value: I designed and developed Musica Show, an app that connects music artists with event producers and potential hirers, while giving service and equipment providers a place to showcase their offerings.

details.label: details
details.value: The project covered UI/UX research, design, and prototyping, as well as frontend and backend development and database architecture. Built with TypeScript on React Native, with PostgreSQL as the primary database and JWT-based authentication, the app is optimized for speed and lightweight functionality, running on both Android and iOS with a seamless user experience.

description.label: description
description.value: I built Bolso Bom as a personal project to replace paper-based financial notes with a simple, fast, and user-friendly app for efficient money management.

details.label: details
details.value: The project covered UI/UX research, design, and prototyping, as well as frontend and backend development and database architecture. Developed with TypeScript on React Native, with PostgreSQL as the primary database and JWT authentication, the app is optimized for speed and lightweight functionality, running seamlessly on both Android and iOS.

description.label: description
description.value: I designed and built Atalaia Pro to streamline operational communication in the Atalaia control room, replacing manual spreadsheet-based maneuver forecasts with an automated, real-time system. Built as a Progressive Web App, it works offline and on mobile devices -- essential for maritime pilots at sea. Features include automatic data import, dynamic schedule management, multi-scenario forecast support, and instant updates. Usability testing showed an 82% reduction in report preparation time compared to the previous Excel-based workflow.

details.label: details
details.value: Single Page Application with PWA offline support. Replaces manual Excel-based reports with automated forecast generation. Schedule management simplified with drag-and-drop. Real-time updates for pilots. Responsive design for control room large monitors and small mobile devices. Import algorithm extracts data from external sources. Progressive Web App enables offline access and home screen installation. 82% reduction in report preparation time validated through usability testing.

api-backend.title: API & Backend Systems
api-backend.context: Designing and implementing reliable server-side architectures — REST APIs, database modeling, authentication systems, and observability pipelines.
api-backend.applicability: I designed and built the backends for all 6 of my production projects: Atalaia Pro (Fastify 5 with Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL — 80+ endpoints and role-based auth across 6 user groups), Musica Show (Koa 2 with raw SQL and Firebase OAuth — 19 tables, 80+ endpoints), Avape (Next.js with Prisma 7 on PostgreSQL — 24 tables with a full audit trail), Bolso Bom (PostgreSQL with JWT), Budget (Express with Sequelize on MariaDB), and a podcast platform (Fastify with full Zod schema validation and auto-generated Swagger docs).
api-backend.impact: I delivered 6 production backends, all live behind CI/CD with automated testing and role-based access control.

frontend-engineering.title: Modern Frontend Engineering
frontend-engineering.context: Building performant, accessible, and visually refined single-page applications using component-driven architecture, type-safe development, and modern tooling.
frontend-engineering.applicability: I leveraged this across 4 frontend projects: a React 19 PWA with offline IndexedDB cache, TypeScript 6, Zustand, and TanStack Query/Table (Atalaia Pro — 12 pages, 60+ components, dual router trees for auth); a Next.js 16 app with Prisma 7 and full audit trail (Avape — 14 pages, 24 DB tables); a React 18 admin dashboard with Zustand and Tailwind 3 (Musica Show — 12 routes); and this bilingual portfolio with i18next and code-as-UI aesthetic.
frontend-engineering.impact: I cut select rendering from over 3 seconds to instant using React Window virtualization and TanStack Query caching, and shipped offline-capable PWAs with role-based UI filtering.

mobile.title: Mobile Development
mobile.context: Creating cross-platform native mobile applications for Android and iOS using React Native with shared TypeScript business logic.
mobile.applicability: I delivered 3 mobile applications from scratch: a personal finance app (Bolso Bom) with React Native, a PostgreSQL backend, and JWT authentication; the Musica Show community marketplace app connecting musicians and producers; and a social podcast app with chat rooms, media management, and user group permissions.
mobile.impact: I shipped 3 native apps live on both Android and iOS from a single TypeScript codebase, with secure authentication and push notifications.

devops.title: DevOps & Infrastructure
devops.context: Managing self-hosted production infrastructure on VPS environments — container orchestration, observability stacks, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployments.
devops.applicability: I designed and maintain a complete LGTM observability platform (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Prometheus) with 9 containerized services on rootless Podman, 14 alert rules, 8 provisioned dashboards, and SLO-based alerting with a 99.5% availability target. All 6 of my production projects run Docker/Podman Compose with GitHub Actions CI/CD, SSH-based deploys, Nginx reverse proxies, and PostgreSQL exporter monitoring.
devops.impact: I maintain 100% measured availability (against a 99.5% SLO target) across 9 self-hosted services, with about 8 deploys per month, 14 alert rules, 8 dashboards, and 30-day log/metric retention.

ux-strategy.title: UX Strategy & Design
ux-strategy.context: Applying user-centered design methodology from discovery research through high-fidelity prototyping — blending analytical rigor with creative problem-solving.
ux-strategy.applicability: I led 4 complete freelance UI/UX design projects using modern methodologies. I conducted user interviews, competitor analysis, proto-personas, journey mapping, CSD matrices, wireframes, and usability testing, and delivered high-fidelity prototypes in Figma. I applied this design foundation across all development projects.
ux-strategy.impact: I delivered 4 complete design projects for 4 distinct clients. The same user-centered methodology now starts every development project — research before a single line of code.
